Manipur Tensions Rise After Two Youths Found Dead Amidst Violence

Tensions escalated in Manipur after the bodies of two Kuki youths, who had been missing for three days, were found. The discovery led to clashes between protesters and police, who used tear gas. This incident follows a day of violence in which three people were killed in firing.
